gateway.text:
### DNA repair: a tiny cartoon

```text
        DNA “zipper”
     =================
     =================
             ↓
       ⚠️ Damage appears
     ======= X =========

             ↓
     👀 Sensor spots the problem
             ↓
     🚦 Checkpoint says:
        “Pause copying!”

             ↓
   Choose the repair crew:
   
   🩹 BER: fix one damaged DNA “letter”
   ✂️  NER: remove a bulky damaged stretch
   🔤 MMR: correct a copying mismatch
   🧩 HR: use an intact matching template
   🔗 End joining: reconnect broken ends

             ↓
     ✅ Repaired and continue
     ⏸️  Stop dividing
     💀 Or, if damage is too severe, die
```

DNA repair is not one mechanism but a group of systems that recognize and correct different kinds of DNA damage [DNA damage and repair](/education/concepts/cancer-biology/genome-instability-and-repair/dna-damage-and-repair-overview/#how-it-works). Think of DNA as a library book: different repair teams fix a damaged letter, replace a stained strip, or reconnect a torn page. A **checkpoint** is like a pause button—it gives the cell time to repair, but the warning signal alone does not prove that repair succeeded.

One key distinction: **damage** can be repaired before it becomes a lasting **mutation** [The intuition](/education/concepts/cancer-biology/genome-instability-and-repair/dna-damage-and-repair-overview/#the-intuition).

Would you like the next cartoon to focus on **BRCA/HR repair** or on **how PARP inhibitors exploit repair weaknesses**?

sections.pageTitle: DNA damage response inhibitors: which repair dependency?
sections.heading: In one sentence
sections.excerpt: DNA damage response inhibitors interfere with proteins that detect, signal, tolerate, or repair DNA damage, and their effects depend on the particular target and repair state.

sections.pageTitle: DNA damage and repair: an overview
sections.heading: In one sentence
sections.excerpt: DNA repair is a collection of processes that recognize and correct damage to genetic material, with different routes for different kinds of damage.
